notes: Extended abstract in a 2026 USTED postgraduate conference book (pp. 70-76 printed, PDF pages 8-14). Field trial at USTED Mampong campus, 2021 minor and 2022 major seasons, RCBD, 3 replications, two maize varieties x six amendments. Gliricidia sepium is used only as biochar feedstock, so the fodder_banks tag does not apply. Extracted only treatments containing biochar against the unfertilised control (sole 10 t/ha CM and 300 kg/ha NPK arms are not defined practices: rate increases against zero fertiliser). Combined GB+NPK and GB+CM arms are partial_bundle (char not isolated). Per-item costs (chicken manure, NPK, biochar) not extracted separately; the biochar cost of 1282 GH₵/ha for 2.5 t/ha equals that arm's TVC row. MRR cells marked D* (dominated) not extracted: GB+NPK in all four tables, 2.5 t/ha GB in Table 4. GH₵ coded GHS (new cedi, 2021-22). Abstract and Results repeat the table net benefits; tables taken.
